en: Changed the questions for stopping auto-connect in `/ide` and for `/clear`, `/compact` or `/rewind` in a subagent's view to list Yes first; they still start on No, so Down then Enter now answers No
zh: 变更 `/ide` 中停止自动连接的问题，以及 subagent 视图中 `/clear`、`/compact` 或 `/rewind` 的问题，将 Yes 列在首位；它们仍默认停在 No，因此现在按 Down 再按 Enter 会回答 No
